about.title: About First Trip
about.storyText: We started in 2017. Not really a tour company — just a group of friends who loved Dahab, running trips for people we knew. The trips grew, the friends grew, and it became a community. Six years and hundreds of trips and thousands of happy people later, we returned in 2026 with a new look and a sharper operation — but the same reason for doing this.
about.visionText: Build Egypt's biggest Dahab-loving community — where people meet through the trip and keep the connection alive after.
about.missionText: Make the trip easy, the pricing open, and the experience real — no theatrics, no surprises.

policy.title: Policy & Refund
policy.bookingText: Booking is confirmed once we receive a 50% deposit. The rest is paid in Dahab. Payment by bank transfer or Vodafone Cash.
policy.cancellationText: Cancelling 7+ days before the trip: full refund. 3-6 days: 50%. Less than 48 hours: no refund.
